spec.title: 静止 — a still scene
spec.input: frames the harness measured as STATIC — scene shift below 1.0 level-0 px
spec.expected: the tracker holds its points where they are, and says TRACKING
spec.passCriteria: >= 15 STATIC frames; median tracked displacement <= 1 px; median forward/backward error <= 1.5 px; tracked survival >= 0.9; the state is never LOST while the scene is static and the count is above 80
spec.failureCondition: points drifting on a still scene, or the state degrading with nothing degrading in the image

testResults.observed: 400 static frames: median displacement 0.025 px, FB 0.001 px, survival 100%, median 74 tracked
testResults.reason: the population stayed where the image stayed. On its own this proves nothing — a tracker returning its input satisfies every line of it perfectly; FLOW-002 is what separates the two, and neither passes without the other

spec.title: ゆっくり横移動 — the anti-fake gate
spec.input: frames measured SLOW (1–12 level-0 px) whose scene-shift confidence cleared 1.1
spec.expected: points follow the image, by the amount the image actually moved
spec.passCriteria: >= 15 SLOW frames and >= 10 paired cross-checks; the median |tracked displacement − independently measured scene shift| within max(2 px, 0.35 × shift); the tracked median displacement itself >= 1 px; tracked survival >= 0.7; median forward/backward error <= 1.5 px
spec.failureCondition: displacement disagreeing with the measured motion — in particular a tracker reporting ~0 while the image demonstrably moved

testResults.observed: 400 cross-checks over 400 slow frames: tracker 4.741 px vs image 4 px, median disagreement 0.95 px within 2 px; 90.5% of frames agreed; survival 97.2%, FB 0.01 px
testResults.reason: what the tracker says the points did agrees with what a separate instrument says the image did. That instrument is an integer SAD translation search on the pyramid’s top level: it shares no code with the solver, never sees the feature list, and keeps its own copy of the previous frame. A tracker returning its input reports zero here while the search reports the real motion, and the disagreement is the failure

spec.title: ゆっくり回転 — rotation
spec.input: frames during which the device's own gyroscope integrated >= 5° over a 1000 ms trailing window — a second independent instrument
spec.expected: tracking survives rotation, and the flow field is not a pure translation
spec.passCriteria: >= 15 rotating frames; tracked survival >= 0.7; median forward/backward error <= 1.5 px; the displacement field's spread across the 8×6 grid measurably larger while rotating than during pure translation
spec.failureCondition: losing the population on a slow rotation; or a flow field identical in every cell, which is a translation-only model rather than a measurement

testResults.observed: 400 rotating frames at a median 5.57° per 1000 ms: survival 96.3%, FB 0.013 px, grid spread 0.813 px rotating vs 0.464 px translating
testResults.reason: the population survived the rotation, and the flow field varied across the frame while it did — measured against the same field during pure translation on the same run, so a scene that would have varied anyway produces no difference and no pass

spec.title: 急速移動 — fast motion
spec.input: frames measured FAST — scene shift above 12 level-0 px
spec.expected: the tracker fails honestly; §65 asks for the transition, not for success
spec.passCriteria: >= 15 FAST frames; survival there measurably lower than during SLOW frames; the fraction of round trips rejected by §13's 3 px band rises; the state reaches DEGRADED or LOST when the tracked count falls below 80, and the state never disagrees with the count displayed beside it
spec.failureCondition: survival unchanged under motion the window cannot span — which means the numbers are not coming from the image; or a count that collapses with the state still reporting GOOD

testResults.observed: 329 fast frames: survival 87.5% against 97.2% slow; §13 rejected 7.1% against 0%; median 27 tracked; states {"READY":1,"TRACKING":746,"DEGRADED":1211,"LOST":759}
testResults.reason: the tracker lost points under motion its window cannot span, the points it lost were rejected by §13 rather than silently dropped, and the state followed the count down. §65 asks for the transition, not for success

spec.title: Camera遮断 — the lens covered
spec.input: frames measured OCCLUDED — a dark frame, or a wholesale change no shift explains
spec.expected: LOST, promptly, and recovery once the lens is uncovered
spec.passCriteria: >= 10 OCCLUDED frames; the state reaches LOST within 1000 ms of the occlusion beginning; no track survives the occlusion with a §13-acceptable round trip; after the lens is uncovered the state leaves LOST
spec.failureCondition: TRACKING maintained through a black frame; or never recovering

testResults.observed: 2 occlusion(s) of 10+ frames; slowest reached LOST in 68.99999999994179 ms and recovered after 35 ms; 0 track(s) claimed a good round trip through the dark
testResults.reason: the state went LOST while the lens was covered, nothing claimed to have tracked across the black frames, and the population came back when the image did

spec.title: Optical flow cost
spec.input: the measured cost of the Lucas-Kanade solve per frame, at §12's parameters
spec.expected: the solve fits §H’s budget, with the point count recorded alongside
spec.failureCondition: over budget. Advisory because §34 ranks correctness above performance, and because a device budget cannot be adjudicated off the device (§H.4)

testResults.observed: 2.668 ms mean over 400 frames at 41 points, 21×21 window, 3 levels, 30 iterations, epsilon 0.01; the independent scene-shift search cost 7.648 ms on top
testResults.reason: the solve fits its budget at the parameters §12 fixes, with the point count it was measured at recorded beside it

spec.title: Metadata honesty
spec.input: the §11 feature records, now that features have a history
spec.expected: forwardBackwardError is a number on tracked records and null on fresh ones; reprojectionError is still null; age and trackLength describe what actually happened
spec.passCriteria: forwardBackwardError a number on every record with age > 0 and null on every record with age 0; reprojectionError null throughout; trackLength never longer than the frames since the record appeared; ids unique
spec.failureCondition: any of the above unmet — in particular a number where none was measured

testResults.observed: 12 records inspected, 12 of them with a history; forwardBackwardError present exactly where a round trip was measured, reprojectionError null throughout, longest track 467 frame(s)
testResults.reason: the record says what was measured and nothing else. §13’s error appears the moment a point has been tracked and not before; §15’s stays null because Phase 6 has not run, and for an error term an invented number is an invented confidence

controller.note: Every decision carries the median worker latency and the budget it was compared against. The controller reads no clock of its own — only the timestamps on the samples it is given (§59).

segmentLog.note: The timeline is cut wherever load injection was switched on or off. FRAME-001 reads the longest unstressed segment; stressed segments are measured and reported but never counted toward continuity.

crossCheckDetail.note: Each pair is one video frame measured twice: on the main thread with an independent 64x48 readback, and in the worker on the pixels the pipeline actually delivered. The readback costs what §H.1 measured, which is why it runs at 1 Hz and is excluded from the pipeline UI cost in FRAME-005.

pipeline.note: Frames declined by rate pacing (pacedOut) are the scheduler working as designed and are not drops. Frames declined because the worker was busy (backpressured) are deliberate too. Only `lost` counts frames that were handed over and never came back, and only that is held against FRAME-001.

flow.note: Motion classes are measured from the image by an integer SAD translation search on the pyramid’s top level, which shares no code with the Lucas-Kanade solver and never reads the feature list. `tracked` counts only points carried forward from the previous frame; `redetected` counts what §11’s refill added, and the two are never summed into a survival figure — a refill can top the population back up while the tracker is losing everything.
